ns2:section.sectionText: Except for occasional Wednesday evening exams/quizzes held at 7 pm (CST) the entire course is asynchronous with no mandatory meeting times. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken.
